purpose: Exercise chat typography and response-card readability across realistic response shapes.
baselineFraming: Answer this request naturally, as you normally would.
reviewFraming: Answer for quick scanning: lead with the useful conclusion, keep paragraphs short, and use a compact list, table, code block, quote, or labeled facts only when that structure makes the answer clearer.
prompts: Explain why leaves change color in autumn in three short paragraphs.
Give me a five-item checklist for preparing for a job interview tomorrow.
Compare renting and buying a home in a compact table with four decision factors.
Write a friendly two-paragraph email declining a meeting because I have a conflict.
Turn this into clear steps: back up the database, run the migration, verify the schema, and roll back if health checks fail.
Show a small TypeScript function that removes duplicate strings while preserving order, then explain it briefly.
Summarize the pros and cons of working four ten-hour days instead of five eight-hour days.
Plan a simple Saturday in San Francisco with morning, afternoon, and evening sections. Avoid live recommendations; this is only an example itinerary.
Explain the difference between authentication and authorization using one analogy and one technical example.
Create a grocery list for vegetarian tacos, grouped by produce, pantry, dairy, and optional toppings.
Rewrite this note so it is calm and direct: We keep missing the deadline and nobody tells me what is blocked until the last second.
Give me a decision tree for whether to fix a bug now, schedule it, or close it as not planned. Use plain text, not Mermaid.
Explain compound interest with a $1,000 example at 5% annual growth for three years.
Create a prioritized backlog from these items: fix login crash, change button color, improve search speed, update help copy, add export to CSV.
Draft release notes with headings for New, Improved, and Fixed, using two concise bullets in each section.
Show how to make an accessible HTML button, including the code and three common mistakes to avoid.
Explain this error in plain language and suggest next steps: ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432.
Give me a one-week beginner running plan with rest days and distances in a table.
Write a short quote-style callout that reminds a team to verify evidence before claiming a task is complete, then explain why it matters.
Organize a project status update with labels for Status, Completed, In progress, Risks, and Next step.
Explain when to use bullets versus numbered lists versus a table in an AI assistant response.
Create a compact recipe card for banana pancakes with prep time, cook time, ingredients, and four steps.
Review this password policy and point out ambiguities: Passwords should be strong, changed regularly, and not reused too often.
Show a nested checklist for launching a small website: content, design, engineering, and final QA.
Explain the request-response lifecycle of a web page as a six-step timeline.
Format these metrics so they are easy to scan: signups 1240, activation 63%, weekly retention 41%, support tickets 87, uptime 99.95%.
Give a concise critique of a dashboard that uses six card styles, five accent colors, and three different heading scales.
Explain how a very long unbroken identifier such as customer_eu-west-1_01JAVERYLONGIDENTIFIERTHATSHOULDWRAPSAFELY should render in a chat response.
Create a short meeting summary with Decisions, Open questions, Owners, and Due dates using fictional details.
Explain how to read this URL without letting it break the layout: https://example.com/a/very/long/path/with?many=parameters&that=need&safe=wrapping&inside=a-chat-card
